title: In Scandinavia babies sleep their naps outside all year round - even ...
description: In Scandinavia babies sleep their naps outside all year round - even in the cold winter ❄️  We use special sleeping bags and high quality wool clothing to keep them warm and comfortable 🐑  It is common in Scandinavia to leave your baby sleeping alone outside at your residence and even when going out to cafes etc. 👶🏽 It’s very common to see strollers with sleeping babies parked on the outside of restaurants and cafes ☕️  We even have them sleeping in the sledge when we cross country ski ⛷️ 😅 Scandinavia is in general incredibly safe which is a HUGE privilege in this day and age ❤️ To be able to go about your day and leave your baby to sleep outside without having to worry about kidnappings or other crimes is almost utopic for most parents in the world 🌍 Something to be very grateful for 🙏🏼 In Norway we keep our newborns inside the first 4 weeks and we don’t have them sleeping outside in less than -10 degrees Celsius ❄️ It is believed that the fresh air improves sleep and it certainly helps the newborns infants wake up refreshed 👶🏼 What do you think about this? Would this be possible where you live? 🌍 #Baby #infant #babysleep #babystroller #babysleepoutside #babynaps #parenting #parentingtips #parentinghacks #parentinginfo #newbornbaby #newborn #firsttimemom
